role: CI gate: for an .xcstrings catalogue, the worst non-source locale's translated share of translatable keys must be at least .ci/min_localization_coverage.txt (100).
toplevel: set -euo pipefail. CATALOGUE=$1 or Emuqu/Localizable.xcstrings (missing -> 66); FLOOR_FILE=$2 or .ci/min_localization_coverage.txt (missing -> 66, empty -> 65). Python: keys with shouldTranslate != false; locales = union of localization keys minus source (none -> 65); is_translated requires stringUnit state 'translated' with a value, or every variation case translated with plural 'other' present; worst locale < floor -> exit 1. Summary echoed and appended to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY. Wired for Localizable, Emuqu/InfoPlist, Watch InfoPlist and Help catalogues in gates.yml/ci.yml/Makefile.

flags.text: Locales are inferred from the catalogue itself, so a locale whose entries are all removed disappears from the denominator instead of failing.
